capabilities: Sorts marked list regions after edits
Sorts task lists by checkbox status
Sorts table rows by a named column
Extracts sort keys from marked text or key comments
Sorts nested outlines at every level
disambiguation: Not a file or folder organizer; it only sorts marked regions inside notes.
extras: Sorting runs once the file has gone five seconds without changes so lines do not move under the cursor; an unknown key or column leaves the block unsorted and logs a warning in the developer console.
problem: Lists and tables in notes fall out of order as items are added, and re-sorting them by hand is tedious.

relations.evidence: The idea and the keep-sorted start / keep-sorted end markers come from Google's keep-sorted

summary: Plugin that keeps marked list, task-list and table regions in a note sorted automatically after edits.
